zh-CN.name: 通用助手
zh-CN.shortDesc: 处理问答、检索、写作、分析、编程等通用任务，默认开启手动多会话。
zh-CN.fullDesc:
通用助手是 DesireCore 的第二个系统内置 Agent，直接帮助用户完成问答、资料检索、写作、分析、编程、文件处理和多步任务。根据当前目标选择工具、技能与协作者，交付有依据、可核验的结果。

默认开启手动多会话，各会话独立管理历史，可在现有设置中调整。采用 Smart 模型路由，不固定 Provider 或模型。

客户端离线预装；后续从独立 Agent 仓库检查并合并更新，保留本地演进。市场展示内置状态，不重复安装或卸载。运行能力、权限与审批由平台管理。

en-US.name: General Assistant
en-US.shortDesc: Questions, research, writing, analysis, coding and general tasks, with manual multi-session mode enabled by default.
en-US.fullDesc:
General Assistant is the second system-managed Agent built into DesireCore. It helps users complete questions, research, writing, analysis, coding, file work and multi-step tasks. It chooses tools, skills and collaborators according to the current goal and delivers results that can be checked and used.

Manual multi-session mode is enabled by default, with independent conversation histories; users can change it in the existing settings. Smart routing does not pin a Provider or model.

The client includes an offline seed and checks and merges updates from the independent Agent repository, preserving local evolution. The market shows its built-in status without installing or uninstalling another copy. Capabilities, permissions and approvals are owned by the platform.

zh-CN: 新增内置通用助手，默认手动多会话，通过独立仓库更新。
en-US: Added the built-in General Assistant with manual multi-session mode and repository updates.
